item.title: Aspire: Free GED Prep, Tutoring, Adult Literacy, and Basic Skills Classes
item.description:
Date: Monday, September 7, 2026
Time: 10:30am - 1:00pm
Location: Glenville - Community Space 1
Branch: Glenville

This series of free Aspire adult education classes is presented by the Neighborhood Centers Association. NSA provides free education and tutoring for adults (and teens ages 16 and up). These classes are for beginning readers, those seeking a GED or HiSET, or high school grads who need to improve skills for college, employment, or career advancement.


Registration is required. Register here or call 216-727-3825.  For more information, visit https://www.gcnca.org/aspire/.
